nurse.text: Welcome to the Sanctuary. We get a lot of visitors who've been chased by a moose. Have you been chased by a moose?
What can we do for you?

then.text: Lie them down there. I'll put the kettle on.
All better. Steady as a lobster boat.
The Ark's in the back by the woodstove.

else.text: Mar sin leibh! Goodbye for now.
